info.name: Workflow Engine API
info.description: REST API for the workflow execution engine. Optional header: X-Tenant-ID to scope workflows by tenant. Request body can include `tenant` on create/update; it is stored in the workflow table. Variables: `base_url`, `workflow_id`, `execution_id`, `tenant`, `template_slug`.

variable.description: Required for create (non-empty). Optional for list/get/trigger to scope by tenant.
Node template slug. Set by Create/Publish Node Template.

header.description: Optional. Tenant value; workflow is created under this tenant if body does not set tenant.

request.description: Create a workflow. **tenant** is required (string, in body or X-Tenant-ID header, non-empty). Optional `version` (number, default 1). New workflow is set as latest for that name. Response includes id, name, version, is_latest, created_at. Saves `id` to `workflow_id`.

header.description: Optional. Only workflows for this tenant are returned.

request.description: List workflows (id, name, version, is_latest, created_at). If X-Tenant-ID is set, only that tenant's workflows are returned.

header.description: Optional. If set, returns 404 when workflow belongs to a different tenant.

request.description: Get a single workflow (id, tenant, name, version, is_latest, definition, etc.). Uses variable `workflow_id`. With X-Tenant-ID, workflow must belong to that tenant.

header.description: Optional. Workflow must belong to this tenant.

request.description: Update workflow by id. Body: optional "tenant" (string, stored in workflow), optional "definition" (full React Flow JSON), optional "is_latest" (true to mark this workflow as the latest for its name). At least one field should be provided.

header.description: Optional. If set, returns 404 when workflow belongs to a different tenant.

request.description: Delete a workflow by id. This also deletes all of the workflow's executions and their steps (ON DELETE CASCADE). Returns { id, deleted: true }, or 404 if the workflow does not exist (or belongs to a different tenant when X-Tenant-ID is set).

header.description: Optional. When triggering by name, lookup is scoped to this tenant; when by UUID, workflow must belong to this tenant.
Optional; headers are stored in Webhook context

request.description: Trigger by UUID or name. Without ?version=, the workflow marked is_latest for that name is used; use ?version=1 to run a specific version. Response includes execution_id, status, result (last completed node output when completed), and error (when failed). Saves execution_id.

header.description: Optional. Lookup by name is scoped to this tenant.

request.description: Trigger by name. Optional ?version=1; omit to use the workflow marked is_latest for that name. X-Tenant-ID scopes by tenant. Response includes execution_id, status, result (last completed node output when completed), and error (when failed).

Start workflow in step-by-step (debug) mode. Creates an execution with status paused and does not run any nodes. Use Run next step to advance. Response includes execution_id, status=paused, result=null, error=null. Saves execution_id.

header.description: Optional. If set, only executions for workflows belonging to this tenant are returned.

query.description: Optional. Filter executions by workflow UUID.

request.description: List executions (id, workflow_id, workflow_version, status, context, started_at, finished_at). Optional query: workflow_id to filter by workflow. Optional header X-Tenant-ID to scope by tenant.

header.description: Optional. If set, returns 404 when the execution's workflow belongs to a different tenant.

request.description: Get execution (id, workflow_id, workflow_version, status, context, steps, etc.). Uses variable execution_id. X-Tenant-ID enforces tenant.

header.description: Optional. Execution's workflow must belong to this tenant.

request.description: Run the next step for a paused execution (step-by-step mode). Execution must be in paused state. Returns execution with updated status and steps. Use execution_id from Trigger Webhook (step mode).

item.name: Node Templates
item.description: Reusable, versioned node definitions. Use one in a workflow with a node `{ "type": "template", "data": { "template": "<slug>", "version"?: n, "params": {...} } }`.

request.description: Create a template (version 1), or publish the next version if `slug` exists. Body: `slug`, `node_type` (HttpRequest, ServiceCall, WorkflowCall, SetVariable, If, Switch), `config` (the node's data; reads params as `{{ params.x }}`), `params` (`{ name: { required?, default?, label?, description? } }`), optional `name`/`description`. Identical content returns the latest version with `created: false` (200). 409 when nodes following the latest version would lack a new required param; add `?force=true` to publish anyway. Saves `slug` to `template_slug`.
Latest version of each template. `?all_versions=true` lists every version.

Publish the body as the next version (same body as create, without `slug`). Versions are immutable; workflows referencing the template without `version` pick it up on their next run. `?force=true` skips the breaking-change check.
Workflow nodes using the template: `usages` (`workflow_id`, `workflow_name`, `workflow_version`, `node_id`, `version` — null = follows latest) with `floating`/`pinned` counts.
Delete the template, or one version with `?version=N`. 409 while workflow nodes still use it (for one version: nodes pinned to it, or following latest when it is the latest).
